WTXS21 PGTW 171800
MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION ALERT(INVEST 96S)//
RMKS/
1. FORMATION OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE IS POSSIBLE WITHIN
130 NM EITHER SIDE OF A LINE FROM 5.2S 90.3E TO 8.6S 88.3E WITHIN
THE NEXT 12 TO 24 HOURS. AVAILABLE DATA DOES NOT JUSTIFY ISSUANCE
OF NUMBERED TROPICAL CYCLONE WARNINGS AT THIS TIME. WINDS IN THE
AREA ARE ESTIMATED TO BE 28 TO 33 KNOTS. METSAT IMAGERY AT
171700Z INDICATES THAT A CIRCULATION CENTER IS LOCATED NEAR 5.6S
90.2E. THE SYSTEM IS MOVING SOUTH-SOUTHWESTWARD AT 07 KNOTS.
2. REMARKS: THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 96S) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 
0.8S 91.7E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 5.6S 90.2E, APPROXIMATELY 566 NM 
NORTHWEST OF COCOS ISLANDS. ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED(EIR) SATELLITE 
DEPICTS PERSISTENT DEEP CONVECTION BUILDING OVER THE CENTER. A 171521Z 
ASCAT-B PASS SHOWS NEAR GALE-FORCE WINDS ALONG THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF 
THE LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER (LLCC). ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS REVEALS 
A MARGINAL ENVIRONMENT FOR DEVELOPMENT WITH MODERATE TO HIGH VERTICAL 
WIND SHEAR (VWS) OF (20 TO 25 KNOTS), GOOD POLEWARD UPPER-LEVEL OUTFLOW, 
AND WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (SSTS) OF (28 TO 29 C). WHILE GLOBAL 
DETERMINISTIC AND ENSEMBLE MODELS DEPICT A STEADY-STATE INTENSITY TREND 
OVER THE NEXT 24-36 HOURS, ONLY A SLIGHT INCREASE IN ORGANIZATION IS 
NEEDED FOR 96S TO BECOME A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE AS IT TRACKS 
SOUTH-SOUTHWESTWARD. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 28 
TO 33 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1006 MB. 
THE POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE 
WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS IS HIGH.
3. THIS ALERT WILL BE REISSUED, UPGRADED TO WARNING OR CANCELLED BY 
181800Z.//
NNNN
